formative_worksheets.title: The Direction and Position Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (8 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming directions and positions before debugging.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can use directions and record code.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use directions and record code.
header.character_watermark: Bot the Robot with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.visual_layout: Two arrows and two direction word options to match.

image_placeholders.description: Two arrow icons (forward, right) for Kindergarten formative check, B&W line art. Below: word options FORWARD, RIGHT.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_DIR at Prompt 1: keywords name the arrow direction match task.

prompts.answer_key: Arrow up = FORWARD, arrow right = RIGHT.

prompts.prompt: Where is Bot? Circle the right word.
prompts.visual_layout: A picture of Bot above a star with four position word options.

image_placeholders.description: Picture of Bot above a star for Kindergarten formative check, B&W line art. Below: ABOVE / BELOW / BESIDE / BETWEEN circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_POS at Prompt 2: keywords name the above-the-star circle task.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for Kindergarten formative check, B&W line art.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.

reflection_sheet.title: My Little Programmer Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Bot and Buggy with a Junior Programmer certificate in the top-right. References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: How do you feel? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals for Kindergarten reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_STARS at Prompt 1: keywords name the star rating visual.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table for Kindergarten reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_YN_TABLE at Prompt 2: keywords name response options.

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for Kindergarten reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_FAV_BOX at Prompt 3: keywords name the favourite activity focus.

prompts.prompt: The trickiest part for me was...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for Kindergarten reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_TRICKY_BOX at Prompt 4: keyword names the trickiest part focus.

prompts.prompt: Next time, I want to try...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for Kindergarten reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_NEXT_BOX at Prompt 5: keywords name the next-time focus.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the end of Lesson 5 alongside Junior Programmer certificate.
